events.text: The frogs in the paddies sing all night. You decide to learn their song.

effects.log: The frogs go silent in shock. You are very proud.
Frogs keep perfect time. So, soon, do your feet.

events.text: The village children fight kite battles, cutting each other's strings with glass-coated lines.

ok.log: Your kite rules the sky. Undefeated kite champion of the village.

fail.log: Your kite is cut first. It flies free over the mountains.

effects.log: It flies highest of all, because no one bothers it.

events.text: The old ginkgo by the shrine: no child has ever reached the top.

ok.log: You touch the top branch. The whole village sees you up there.

fail.log: Halfway up, a branch breaks. Your arm is purple for a week.

choices.text: Climb halfway and enjoy the view

effects.log: Halfway is higher than anyone else has been.

events.text: The village children found a sect of their own in the mud by the river. It needs a leader.

effects.log: Your first act: everyone must bring you rice cakes. The mud sect lasts until dinner.
Every good story has a humble sweeper who is secretly the strongest.

events.text: The village blacksmith lets you pump the bellows while he makes a sword.

effects.log: The sword comes out beautiful. Your arms come out stronger.
Folded twelve times, he says, so it bends and does not break. Like people.

events.text: A summer storm fills the courtyard with puddles. Perfect for testing footwork.

effects.log: You miss one. Then all of them. You are completely soaked and completely happy.
Balance and focus. The puddles never touch you.

events.text: A summer night thick with fireflies. You catch them in a paper lantern.

effects.log: A lantern that breathes. You fall asleep watching it.

choices.text: Let them all go at midnight

effects.log: A cloud of light rising over the fields.

events.text: The woodshed at night makes a noise like breathing. The other children dare you to go in.

ok.log: It is a very fat cat. You come out a hero.

fail.log: It is a very angry goose. You come out screaming.

effects.log: 'Chicken,' they say. You are a live chicken, at least.

events.text: A heron stands in the shallows for an hour without moving, then strikes like lightning.

effects.log: You last ten minutes. Your legs shake. You feel wise.
It looks at you with deep contempt and flies away.

events.text: You find a copper coin in the road. It feels like a fortune.

effects.log: The best sweet in the history of sweets.
You hide it under a stone. You check it every day for a year.

events.text: An older boy takes the smaller children's lunches every day at the bridge.

ok.log: He backs off. The small children follow you like ducklings.

fail.log: He knocks you down. The next day, you stand there again.

effects.log: The teacher deals with it. The small children still think you are a hero.

events.text: The first real snow. The children build forts and declare war.

effects.log: A glorious charge. You are buried under snowballs, victorious.
Unconquered. Your fort lasts until spring.

events.text: A wandering monk gives sweets to children who can recite a sutra.

ok.log: A sweet, and the monk's blessing.

fail.log: You invent the last half. The monk laughs and gives you a sweet anyway.

choices.text: Ask the monk for a story instead

effects.log: He tells you about a monk who punched a mountain. You believe him.

events.text: The children swim in the river at the deep bend. The current is stronger than it looks.

ok.log: Across and back. Nobody else dares.

fail.log: The current drags you downstream. You scramble out, shaking.

effects.log: Safe and splashy. A very good afternoon.

events.text: A bird's nest has fallen from the eaves with three eggs still whole.

effects.log: You climb onto the roof with it. The mother bird screams at you and then settles.
Two hatch. You have two very loud friends for a summer.

events.text: A street magician makes a coin disappear from behind your ear.

effects.log: You see the trick on the fourth try. He winks.
Magic is better when you do not know.

events.text: Your best friend challenges you to a stick duel, 'to the death, or until dinner'.

ok.log: You win. Your friend demands a rematch tomorrow.

fail.log: You lose. You demand a rematch tomorrow.

effects.log: The "Spinning Dragon Nonsense" technique. You both fall over laughing.

events.text: The old woman next door is blind and lives alone. She knows everyone by their footsteps.

effects.log: She knows your step now. She tells you old stories and older secrets.

choices.text: Carry her water once a week

effects.log: Small, steady help. She calls you her little hero.

events.text: A great thunderstorm at night. Every child in the house is under a blanket except you, watching at the window.

choices.text: Count between the flash and the thunder

effects.log: You learn the storm is moving away. You tell everyone. You are very scientific.
Your timing is good. The younger children believe you for years.

events.text: A lost puppy follows you around the market, crying.

effects.log: A little girl weeps with joy. Her grandfather gives you a sweet potato.
It follows you home. It is not yours, but it thinks it is.

events.text: An old man practising slow forms in the square lets you copy him for a morning.

effects.log: Slow, slow, slow, then suddenly you understand balance.

choices.text: Ask him what the forms are for

effects.log: 'For being old without falling over,' he says. You laugh. He does not.

events.text: Another child is caught stealing a bun and blames you.

ok.log: The baker believes you. The other child sweeps his shop for a month.

fail.log: Nobody believes you. You sweep the shop.

effects.log: The baker is so surprised he gives you both a bun.

events.text: An old woman tells you a rabbit lives on the moon, pounding medicine for immortality.

effects.log: You look for the rabbit every full moon for years. Sometimes you see it.
'The kind that makes you live forever,' she says. 'Very boring, forever.'

events.text: You catch a frog and are told that kissing it will turn it into a prince.

effects.log: It is still a frog. It is a very surprised frog.
It might have been a prince. It is better off a frog.

events.text: A group of older children from the next village come looking for trouble at the river.

ok.log: The next village goes home wet.

fail.log: You all go home wet. Honour intact.

choices.text: Challenge their leader to a race instead

effects.log: You win. The villages are friends by summer.

events.text: You are old enough now to light the incense at the family shrine.

effects.log: You read every ancestor's name. Some of them were martial artists.
One was a famous swordsman. One ran away with a singer. Both stories are better than yours so far.

events.text: The baby, {npc}, gets all the attention now. You feel invisible.

effects.log: The baby grabs your finger and will not let go. You are not invisible to the baby.
You come back at dinner. Everyone was frantic. You are secretly pleased.

events.text: A fever makes you dream of a swordsman in white walking across a lake.

effects.log: You wake knowing how he stepped. Perhaps it was only a dream.
You will see that face again, years later. You will not believe it.

events.text: A travelling troupe performs 'The Heavenly Demon Defeated' in the market.

effects.log: You cheer so loudly the actor playing the hero bows to you.
The Demon actor notices, and winks.

events.text: Shouting into the old well makes it shout back. The children take turns.

effects.log: The well repeats it. You feel sure it heard.
The well knows who you are now.

events.text: Someone smiles at you across the market, and suddenly you cannot remember how to walk.

effects.log: You say something ridiculous. They laugh. It is the start of something.
Everyone sees. You will be famous for this for years.

events.text: You grow four inches in one year. Nothing fits, and you keep hitting your head on doorways.

effects.log: Longer arms, longer strikes.
Everyone agrees you have become very tall and very annoying.

events.text: You start rising before dawn to train alone where nobody can see.

effects.log: A year of secret dawns. You are much better than anyone knows.
They join you. It becomes a group. It is more fun and less secret.

events.text: Older boys dare you to bet your savings on a dice game behind the temple.

effects.log: They call you boring. You are richer than all of them by winter.
The dice are weighted. You learn to spot it forever.

events.text: You are tired of being told what to do by everyone.

choices.text: Go on a long solitary walk

effects.log: Three days in the hills. You come back calmer and very hungry.

choices.text: Argue with everyone for a month

effects.log: Everyone agrees it was a very long month.

events.text: A famous swordsman passes through town. Every young person follows him around.

effects.log: 'Train when you do not want to,' he says. It is annoying because it is true.
You look ridiculous for a month, and walk with more confidence forever.

events.text: The tavern needs a dishwasher for the summer.

effects.log: Wrinkled hands and a pocket of silver. (8 taels)
No money, stronger legs.

events.text: Your best friend tells everyone a secret you told only them.

effects.log: They cry and apologise. It takes a long time to trust again.
You learn to keep your secrets closer.

events.text: A rich boy from the next town insults your village. The whole town expects you to answer.

ok.log: You win. The town talks about it for a year.

fail.log: You lose. The town talks about it for a year, differently.

effects.log: The rich boy is baffled. The town is disappointed, then impressed.

events.text: You and your friends climb onto the temple roof at midnight to look at the stars.

effects.log: You talk about everything you will become. Some of it comes true.

choices.text: Get down before the monks wake

effects.log: Sensible. Mostly. A monk sees your feet disappear over the edge.

events.text: You have started writing poems. They are all about death and the moon.

effects.log: The poems get better. Much later, one of them is actually good.
The smoke smells of heartbreak and cheap ink.

events.text: Your voice cracks in the middle of reciting in front of the whole class.

effects.log: Squeaks and all. The teacher respects it.
Nobody believes you. Everybody appreciates the attempt.

events.text: An old warrior on the road offers to teach you one thing if you carry his pack for a day.

effects.log: At sunset he shows you how to fall without getting hurt. The most useful thing you ever learn.
He shrugs and walks on. You wonder about it for years.

events.text: The county exam for young scholars is next month. Half your friends are studying; half are pretending.

ok.log: You pass near the top. Your name goes on the wall.

fail.log: You pass, barely. It still counts.

effects.log: You fail cheerfully. The murim does not check exam results.

events.text: There is a festival in the next town and everyone is going, officially or not.

effects.log: Lanterns, music, and trouble when you get home. Worth it.
The empty yard, the far-off music, and a stronger you.

events.text: Your friend picks a fight with three older boys and looks at you for help.

ok.log: Two against three, and you win. Your friendship is iron now.

fail.log: You both lose. You laugh about it for years.

effects.log: It works, somehow. Your friend is annoyed and alive.

events.text: The person you liked has chosen someone else. The whole village knows.

effects.log: You punch a tree for a week. The tree loses.
It rhymes "heart" with "apart" four times. It helps anyway.

events.text: The village carpenter offers to take you as an apprentice.

effects.log: You learn to build a table, and patience. (+5 taels)
He shakes your hand. "Come back if the murim does not want you."

events.text: You and two friends swear an oath under the peach trees to become great masters together.

effects.log: Three children, three bowls of water raised like a toast. Years later, you all remember.

choices.text: Add a clause about staying friends

effects.log: Everyone agrees that is the important part.

events.text: You push your training too far and tear something in your shoulder.

effects.log: Two months of boredom. The shoulder heals fully.
It heals badly. You feel it every winter for the rest of your life.
